overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（7 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、金融科技（1 篇）。方法上以数值模拟、调查数据为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（6 篇）、arXiv（2 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 2 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Sustaining democracy under the shadow of force
papers.abstract: Democracy faces two threats: incumbents may peacefully monopolize office, or political factions may seek power through violent conflict. Using a dynamic model, the authors examine some conditions under which democracy is sustainable against both threats. Two parties vie for office under the shadow of force. To resolve conflict, the incumbent can share revenue as well as hold competitive elections: each time, it chooses the probability of losing the next election and redistributes revenue. Elections enable the incumbent to concede control over revenue over time but come with regular risks of defeat. Democracy is sustainable if the economic stakes in elections are neither too low nor too high, while the military strength is sufficiently balanced between the two parties. When the stakes are high, democracy may be sustained only with civilian control of the military or programmatic transfers.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】民主制度面临两大威胁：一方面，执政者可能通过和平手段垄断权力；另一方面，政治派系可能通过暴力冲突来争夺权力。作者利用动态模型研究了在何种条件下民主制度能够抵御这两种威胁并保持稳定。在暴力阴影的笼罩下，两个政党相互竞争执政权。为了解决冲突，执政者可以选择分享财政收入并同时举行选举：每次选举中，执政者都会评估自己输掉下一次选举的概率，并据此重新分配财政收入。虽然选举使执政者逐渐放弃对财政收入的控制权，但同时也伴随着定期可能遭遇失败的风险。只有当选举中的经济利益既不太低也不太高，且两党之间的军事力量保持平衡时，民主制度才能得以维持。当选举中的经济利益过高时，民主制度唯有通过文职人员控制军队或实施有针对性的经济转移措施才能得以延续。。

papers.title: Cross-cultural validation of the AAQ-II in five countries: A SEM and psychometric network analysis approaches
papers.abstract:
Background
                    Experiential avoidance (EA) describes the tendency to evade negative internal experiences (e.g., distressing thoughts, emotions). EA is implicated across mental health conditions, positioning it as a central target for interventions like Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT). The Acceptance and Action Questionnaire-II (AAQ-II) is widely employed to measure EA; however, its cross-cultural reliability and factorial stability have not been comprehensively validated across diverse contexts.
                  
                  
                    Aim
                    This study aimed to assess the cross-cultural validity and psychometric stability of the AAQ-II across five countries (Peru, Mexico, USA, Belgium, and Hungary) using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) and network analysis.
                  
                  
                    Method
                    A sample of 3,719 adults, primarily female (63.65%), was collected from five countries. Data analysis included SEM to evaluate factorial structure and network analysis to examine item interrelationships, assessing Expected Influence (EI) as a centrality measure. Multiverse analysis using 5,000 bootstrap samples further evaluated network stability across samples.
                  
                  
                    Results
                    SEM confirmed a unidimensional AAQ-II structure across all regions, indicating consistent factorial validity. Network analysis identified "Painful Memories" (AAQ4) and "Painful Experiences" (AAQ1) as central nodes across cultures, with regional variations in item relationships reflecting unique sociocultural influences. For instance, individualistic societies (e.g., USA) emphasized EA linked to achievement and competitive concerns, while collectivist countries (e.g., Peru, Mexico) associated EA with familial and social obligations. Multiverse analysis revealed stable EA constructs across samples.
                  
                  
                    Discussion
                    Results validate the cross-cultural applicability of the AAQ-II, with findings underscoring cultural impacts on EA manifestations. Network analysis provided nuanced insights into item interactions, showing that cultural factors, such as individualism, historical trauma, and social norms, shape EA expression differently across regions. This supports the use of culturally informed approaches in EA interventions.
                  
                  
                    Conclusion
                    The AAQ-II exhibits reliable cross-cultural validity, affirming its utility for assessing EA across diverse settings. These findings enhance the application of the tool in psychological therapies worldwide, suggesting that culturally tailored EA interventions may benefit from considering specific sociocultural factors influencing EA processes. Future research should investigate additional variables that may affect EA in different cultural contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】**背景**  
经验回避（Experience Avoidance, EA）是指个体倾向于逃避负面内在体验（如痛苦的想法和情绪）的行为。这种倾向在多种心理健康问题中都存在，因此成为接纳与承诺疗法（Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, ACT）等干预措施的核心目标。接纳与行动问卷第二版（Acceptance and Action Questionnaire-II, AAQ-II）被广泛用于测量经验回避现象；然而，其跨文化信度和因子稳定性尚未在多种情境下得到全面验证。  

**目的**  
本研究旨在通过结构方程建模（Structural Equation Modeling, SEM）和网络分析，评估AAQ-II在五个国家（秘鲁、墨西哥、美国、比利时和匈牙利）的跨文化有效性和心理测量稳定性。  

**方法**  
研究从这五个国家招募了3,719名成年人作为样本，其中女性占多数（63.65%）。数据分析包括使用SEM来评估量表的因子结构，并通过网络分析来考察各项目之间的相互关系，同时以“预期影响”（Expected Influence, EI）作...。

papers.title: Eliminating Make-Whole Uplifts with a Minimum-Cost Uniform Price Adder
papers.abstract: Co-optimizing energy and flexible ramping reserves may dispatch generators at locational marginal prices (LMPs) below their submitted energy offer prices, necessitating out-of-market make-whole payments. Such payments create discriminatory settlements among generators and may incentivize strategic bidding for higher profits. This paper proposes LMP+U, an in-market uniform price adder to LMP for transmission-constrained networks, which minimizes demand payments subject to zero out-of-market make-whole uplift, preserves LMP-based congestion charges, and provides locally truthful bidding incentives for price-taking generators. We also identify conditions under which a price-taking generator can increase its profit by inflating its energy offer under conventional LMP with make-whole uplift. Numerical simulations illustrate the properties of LMP+U and its advantages over conventional LMP in congested networks.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】协同优化能源供应与灵活的调峰储备机制可能导致发电机以低于其提交能源报价的价格（即节点边际价格LMP）进行发电，从而需要支付市场外的补偿费用。这种补偿机制在发电机之间造成了不公平的结算结果，并可能促使某些发电机采取策略性投标行为以获取更高利润。本文提出了一种名为LMP+U的新定价机制：在LMP基础上增加一个统一的价格加成，适用于存在输电限制的网络。该机制能够在不增加市场外补偿费用的前提下最小化用户支付成本，同时保留基于LMP的拥堵收费机制，并为那些接受市场价格波动的发电机提供合理的投标激励。我们还分析了在何种条件下，通过提高能源报价（同时承担市场外补偿费用），接受市场价格的发电机能够增加自身利润。数值模拟结果进一步验证了LMP+U机制的优越性，表明其在拥堵网络中的表现优于传统的LMP定价方式。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Reconstructing risk preferences from data
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of reconstructing risk preferences from data. Specifically, for a finite dataset consisting of contingent claims and their evaluations, we aim at reconstructing a risk measure that is finite-valued, cash-additive, convex, and Lipschitz continuous. Our first result establishes necessary and sufficient conditions for a dataset to be compatible with a risk measure, that is the evaluations are stemming from a risk measure applied to the contingent claims. Our second result provides a reconstruction formula for compatible datasets, which we term \emph{universal risk measure}. We further extend the reconstruction to monotone risk measures and establish sharp Lipschitz constants for both general and monotone reconstructions. We further show that we explicitly reconstruct linear preferences and evaluations by the Expected Shortfall. We conclude with a numerical application to European options.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了从数据中重构风险偏好问题。具体而言，对于一个包含或有索赔及其评估值的有限数据集，我们的目标是重构一个满足以下条件的风险度量：该度量具有有限值、可现金累加性、凸性以及利普希茨连续性。我们的第一个结果提出了数据集与风险度量相兼容的必要充分条件，即这些评估值应当源自对该或有索赔应用的风险度量所得。第二个结果为兼容的数据集提供了一个重构公式，我们将其称为“通用风险度量”。我们进一步将重构方法扩展到单调风险度量，并为一般情况及单调情况下的重构过程确定了精确的利普希茨常数。此外，我们还证明了可以通过预期亏损（Expected Shortfall）方法明确地重构线性偏好和评估值。最后，我们通过一个关于欧式期权的数值案例对研究成果进行了验证。。

papers.title: Youth policy as economic investment: Human capital, digital youth work and local development in the European Union
papers.venue: Central European Review of Economics & Finance
papers.abstract: European youth policy is conventionally analysed through the lenses of participation, inclusion, citizenship, mobility and personal development. However, many of its instruments also generate effects that are economically significant, although they are not always captured by conventional measures of public expenditure efficiency. Investment in youth work, non-formal education, digital learning environments and the institutional capacity of youth organisations may contribute to human capital formation, employability, social capital, organisational productivity and local development. This article examines the economic dimension of European Union youth policy, with particular attention to the growing role of digital youth work and reusable educational resources.The study is conceptual and analytical in character. It combines an analysis of the EU Youth Strategy 2019–2027, the European Youth Work Agenda and the European digital education framework with selected socioeconomic indicators and literature on human capital, non-formal learning, employability and social capital. Five principal mechanisms through which youth-policy interventions may generate economic value are identified: human-capital accumulation, enhancement of labour-market preparedness, formation of social capital, strengthening of organisational capacity and economies of scale associated with digital educational resources.The analysis indicates that youth policy should not be interpreted exclusively as redistributive or social expenditure. Under appropriate institutional conditions, it can constitute a form of developmental public investment whose benefits accumulate at individual, organisational and territorial levels. Digitalisation further strengthens this investment dimension by enabling learning resources to be reused across institutions, locations and successive groups of beneficiaries. Nevertheless, the article argues against reducing the economic value of youth work to short-term employment effects or attempting to monetise complex social outcomes without sufficient causal evidence.The paper proposes a multidimensional framework for assessing the economic effects of youth policy based on human capital, organisational productivity, resource utilisation, network effects and long-term socioeconomic outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融科技】欧洲的青年政策传统上是通过参与度、包容性、公民权、流动性和个人发展等视角来分析的。然而，这些政策的许多措施也会产生具有经济意义的影响，尽管这些影响并不总能被传统的公共支出效率衡量指标所捕捉到。对青年工作、非正规教育、数字学习环境以及青年组织的机构能力的投资，可能有助于促进人力资本积累、提高就业能力、增强社会资本、提升组织生产力以及促进地方发展。本文探讨了欧盟青年政策的经济维度，特别关注数字青年工作和可重复使用的教育资源所发挥的日益重要的作用。

本研究具有概念性和分析性特征，结合了对《2019–2027年欧盟青年战略》《欧洲青年工作议程》及《欧洲数字教育框架》的分析，并参考了有关人力资本、非正规学习、就业能力和社会资本的相关文献。文章指出了青年政策干预措施产生经济价值的五种主要机制：人力资本积累、提升劳动力市场适应能力、社会资本的形成、组织能力的增强，以及与数字教育资源相关的规模经济效应。分析表明，青年政策不应仅仅被视为一种再分配措施或社会支出；在适当的制度条件下，它可以成为一种发展型公共投资，其效益能够在个人、组织和区域层面得到累积。数字化进一步强化了这一投资效应，因为它使得学...。

papers.title: The Role of Sustainability Perception and Trust in Islamic Banking Adoption: Evidence from Bangladesh
papers.venue: Journal of Islamic Monetary Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This paper examines how consumer acceptability and loyalty to Islamic banking in Bangladesh are influenced by perceptions of sustainability, trust, and religious beliefs. The Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), which views sustainability perception and trust as the primary factors and behavioral intention and brand loyalty as the results, guides the investigation. Religious values are assessed as a cultural trait, and their applicability is reassessed in light of the evolving financial landscape. A structured questionnaire survey is used to gather information from 413 respondents having an experience with Islamic banking in five major Bangladeshi cities. Data are analyzed using SmartPLS 3.0's Structural Equation Modeling (SEM-PLS). The results demonstrate that consumer attitudes, which in turn influence behavioral intention, are significantly influenced by perceptions of sustainability and trust. Conversely, behavioral intention predicts brand loyalty, demonstrating its mediation function. However, religious beliefs have no discernible effect on attitudes or intentions for behavior. The findings suggest that consumers in the nation with a majority of Muslims place a higher value on institutional trust and ethical behavior than they do on religion. Transparency, sustainability reporting, and trust-building initiatives are the main practical implications, whereas longitudinal designs and a range of demographics should be explored in future research.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文探讨了在孟加拉国，消费者对伊斯兰银行的接受度和忠诚度如何受到可持续性认知、信任感以及宗教信仰的影响。研究采用了计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior, TPB），该理论将可持续性认知和信任视为主要影响因素，而行为意图和品牌忠诚度则是其结果。宗教价值观被视为一种文化特征，并根据不断变化的金融环境对其适用性进行了重新评估。研究通过结构化问卷调查收集了来自孟加拉国五个主要城市的413位使用过伊斯兰银行服务的受访者的数据，数据分析采用了SmartPLS 3.0软件的结构方程模型（SEM-PLS）。研究结果表明，消费者的态度（进而影响其行为意图）显著受到可持续性和信任感的影响；相反，行为意图又能够预测品牌忠诚度，体现了其中介作用。然而，宗教信仰对消费者的态度或行为意图并无显著影响。研究结果表明，在这个穆斯林占多数的国家中，消费者更重视机构的信任度和道德行为，而非宗教本身。研究提出的实际建议包括提高透明度、加强可持续性信息披露以及推行信任建设措施；同时，未来的研究应探索纵向研究设计以及更多样化的人口统计特征。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Designing Low Emission Zones: Theory and Evidence
papers.abstract: Low Emission Zones (LEZs), which exclude polluting vehicles from parts of a city, are spreading. Yet how their design affects welfare is poorly understood. Unlike price instruments, LEZs ration access inefficiently, imposing costs on inframarginal drivers of restricted vehicles. In our model, welfare is quasi-convex in LEZ size, yielding bang-bang principles: LEZs should be as large as possible or not implemented at all; cleaner vehicles (e.g., hybrids) could be exempt as transition technologies but later restricted, which may require planner commitment. Using new-car purchases, we find Madrid’s LEZ shifted buyers toward cleaner cars, but the surplus losses of switchers and inframarginal drivers exceeded emission savings.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】低排放区（LEZs）通过限制污染车辆在城市特定区域的通行来改善空气质量，这类政策正在逐渐普及。然而，其设计对公众福利的具体影响仍缺乏深入研究。与价格调控手段不同，低排放区在资源分配上存在效率低下问题，尤其是会对那些勉强符合排放标准的驾驶员造成额外负担。在我们的模型中，公众福利与低排放区的规模呈准凸关系，这启示我们应遵循“要么扩大低排放区的范围，要么干脆不实施该政策”的原则；同时，可以暂时允许更清洁的交通工具（如混合动力汽车）作为过渡性技术使用，但随后再逐步对其实施限制——这一决策需要相关规划者的坚定决心。通过分析新车购买数据，我们发现马德里的低排放区确实促使消费者倾向于购买更环保的汽车，但那些被迫更换出行方式的消费者及勉强符合排放标准的驾驶员所承担的额外成本超过了由此带来的减排效益。。

papers.title: Five Facts About Stablecoins
papers.abstract: We document five facts about payment stablecoins using wallet-level blockchain data from 2020 to 2025. First, stablecoins serve as a transaction currency: onchain volume exceeds Bitcoin’s despite a much smaller supply, velocity has risen sharply, and transactions have shifted toward low-value transfers. Second, using transaction timing to refine exchange-based attribution, we find activity spread across the Americas, Europe, and Asia and fewer cross-regional flows than the standard method implies. Third, we estimate a structural cash-management model on the holdings data and find that the costs of accessing stablecoin wallets have fallen since 2023. Fourth, stablecoins are becoming the settlement currency of a fast-growing onchain credit market, and their growth appears to reallocate rather than destroy credit. Fifth, smart contracts are involved in about a third of Ethereum stablecoin transactions and over two thirds of volume, and protocols such as x402 demonstrate sub-cent machine-to-machine payments. Stablecoins behave as tokenized money, with implications for financial markets and regulation.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】我们利用2020年至2025年的钱包级区块链数据，记录了关于支付型稳定币的五个关键事实：  
1. 稳定币充当交易货币：尽管其供应量远低于比特币，但其链上交易量仍超过了比特币；交易活跃度显著提升，且交易类型更多集中在小额转账上。  
2. 通过分析交易时间信息，我们发现稳定币的交易活动遍布美洲、欧洲和亚洲，跨地区资金流动规模低于传统统计方法所显示的幅度。  
3. 基于持有数据构建的模型显示，自2023年以来使用稳定币钱包的成本有所下降。  
4. 稳定币正逐渐成为快速发展的链上信贷市场的结算工具，其发展趋势更倾向于重新配置信贷资源而非破坏现有信贷体系。  
5. 在以太坊上的稳定币交易中，约有三分之一的交易涉及智能合约，且交易量超过总量的三分之二；某些协议（如x402）实现了低于一美分的机器对机器支付。  
稳定币表现出“代币化货币”的特征，这对金融市场和监管政策具有重要启示意义。。

papers.title: Temporal dependence and variable persistence in daily fluctuations of the peso/dollar exchange rate: Mexico, 2004–2026
papers.venue: Denarius Revista de economía y adminstración
papers.abstract:
This study analyzes the temporal dependence of daily Mexican peso/U.S. dollar
            exchange-rate fluctuations over 2004–2026 using the Hurst exponent, detrended
            fluctuation analysis (dfa), and the semiparametric gph estimator. The sample is divided
            into subperiods associated with different economic and financial episodes and is
            complemented by a rolling-window analysis. The results reveal substantial temporal
            heterogeneity: Hurst, dfa, and gph estimates vary across subperiods and, in some cases,
            provide divergent signals. In the recursive analysis, the signal compatible with
            persistence remains in a majority of windows when window lengths of 181, 252, and 365
            observations are considered, although mean H declines as the window length increases.
            The Ht – Ht (t + 1) representation also shows a concentration of estimates around
            central H levels of approximately H = 0.53–0.55, depending on the window length. These
            findings are consistent with time-varying dependence and changes in the intensity of the
            estimated temporal structure. The evidence does not by itself establish long memory for
            the entire sample, causal relationships between economic episodes and persistence, or a
            formal rejection of the efficient market hypothesis. The phase-space analysis is
            therefore interpreted as an exploratory representation of the recursive dynamics of the
            estimator.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本研究利用赫斯特指数（Hurst exponent）、去趋势波动分析（detrended fluctuation analysis, dfa）和半参数广义自相关（semiparametric GPH）估计方法，分析了2004至2026年间墨西哥比索兑美元汇率波动的时间依赖性。样本数据被划分为与不同经济和金融时期相关的子时段，并通过滚动窗口分析进行了补充研究。研究结果表明存在显著的时间异质性：赫斯特指数、去趋势波动分析及广义自相关估计结果在不同子时段之间存在差异，某些情况下甚至呈现出相反的结论。在递归分析中，当窗口长度分别为181、252和365个观测值时，与汇率持续性相一致的结论在大多数窗口中依然成立；不过随着窗口长度的增加，平均赫斯特指数（H）值有所下降。Ht – Ht(t + 1)的统计分布显示，估计值主要集中在大约H = 0.53–0.55的中心范围内，这一范围会随窗口长度的不同而变化。这些发现表明汇率波动的依赖性具有时间变化性，且其时间结构强度也有所波动。然而，现有证据本身并不能证明整个样本数据具有长期记忆性（long memory），也无法证实不同经济时期之间存在因果关...。

papers.title: Capital formation, large companies, and the economy in the food and beverage industry in Mexico, 2020–2025
papers.venue: Denarius Revista de economía y adminstración
papers.abstract:
This work focuses on showing how capital formation occurs in large companies,
            based on trust and other variables in the food and beverage subsector during the period
            2020-2025. It confirms that capital formation decisions by business groups are
            associated with the level of trust, the social context, and how this drives the
            industry, particularly the food and beverage sector. This represents a sensitive
            reflection of how large capital operates a key asset and factor in the economy. It
            clearly shows that, within the processes of capital formation by individuals, investment
            decisions are linked to trust and other factors during the period of 2020-2025. By using
            a descriptive methodology, statistical series, company indicators, and some quantitative
            variables, it was possible to obtain an economic evaluation of large corporations that
            reveal the state of the industry and how obstacles and challenges are overcome in an
            increasingly competitive environment.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究重点探讨了2020至2025年间，食品饮料子行业中大型企业的资本形成过程，以及这一过程如何受到信任等因素的影响。研究证实，企业集团的资本形成决策与信任水平、社会环境密切相关，并且这些因素对整个行业（尤其是食品饮料行业）的发展具有显著推动作用。这反映了大型企业在经济中如何运作其关键资产和要素。研究还明确指出，在2020至2025年期间，个人层面的资本形成过程中，投资决策与信任及其他因素存在紧密关联。通过采用描述性研究方法、统计数据分析、企业指标及量化变量，本研究对大型企业进行了经济评估，揭示了该行业的现状，以及企业在日益竞争激烈的环境中是如何克服各种障碍和挑战的。。

papers.title: Teaching and economic research within a social structure of domination: ideology and hegemony of the neoclassical paradigm La docencia y la investigción económica en una estructura social de dominio: ideología y hegemonía del paradigma neoclásico
papers.venue: Denarius Revista de economía y adminstración
papers.abstract:
Mainstream approaches to studying the financial system have relied heavily on
            forecasting, underpinned by rational expectations and the efficient market hypothesis.
            While these assumptions facilitate analytical modeling, they offer limited explanatory
            power in periods of systemic crisis and financial contagion. This paper argues that
            framing the financial system as a complex adaptive system (CAS) provides more suitable
            analytical tools for these contexts, particularly given its capacity to incorporate
            agent heterogeneity, recursive causality, and emergent behavior. It further contends
            that agent-based modeling, calibrated with behavioral economics assumptions, can produce
            artificial markets capable of reproducing empirical regularities of real markets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】主流的金融系统研究方法主要依赖于预测分析，这些方法建立在理性预期理论及有效市场假说之上。尽管这些假设有助于构建分析模型，但在系统性危机或金融传染事件发生时，它们的解释能力较为有限。本文认为，将金融系统视为一个复杂适应系统（Complex Adaptive System, CAS）能够为这类研究提供更为合适的分析工具，尤其是该框架能够充分考虑代理行为的异质性、递归因果关系以及新兴行为模式。此外，本文还指出，基于行为经济学的代理模型构建方法，能够生成能够再现真实市场规律的人造市场。。研究方法：模型校准。

papers.title: Artificial intelligence, the labor market, and energy consumption: What do major agencies in Latin America say?
papers.venue: Denarius Revista de economía y adminstración
papers.abstract:
The emergence of generative artificial intelligence (AI) has attracted significant
            attention in recent years; however, there are still few studies that rigorously examine
            its impacts on the labor market and, consequently, on the economy (Roose, 2023; Babina
            et al., 2022; The Adecco Group Institute, 2024). In this context, it is recognized that
            AI is transforming both employment dynamics and energy consumption on a global scale.
            This work aims to preliminarily understand the current state of AI in Latin America and
            review the state of the art on the matter, with special interest in identifying some
            relevant conclusions from three multilateral agencies. Recent studies, like the one by
            Jung and Katz (2026), claim that a 1% increase in AI spending is associated with a
            0.036% growth in GDP, an effect that mainly materializes through improvements in the
            productivity of skilled labor.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】近年来，生成式人工智能（AI）的出现引起了广泛关注；然而，目前仍很少有研究系统地探讨其对劳动力市场乃至经济的影响（Roose, 2023; Babina et al., 2022; The Adecco Group Institute, 2024）。在这一背景下，人们认识到AI正在全球范围内改变就业格局和能源消耗模式。本研究旨在初步了解AI在拉丁美洲的发展现状，并综述相关领域的最新研究成果，特别关注三个多边机构得出的重要结论。例如Jung和Katz（2026）的研究指出，AI支出的每增加1%，GDP就会增长0.036%，这一效应主要体现在熟练劳动生产力的提升上。。
